message.content:
The editorial illustration features a large, cartoonish man with a pale complexion and a white button-down shirt. He wears a dark green combat helmet with a brown chin strap and has exaggerated facial features, including small, squinting eyes and a rounded jaw. He is hunched over several grey, block-like skyscrapers. His right hand is positioned to move a small, green plastic toy soldier on a building roof. Several other green toy soldiers are placed on various rooftops in combat poses, including aiming rifles, kneeling with a bazooka, and crawling. In the background, taller grey rectangular buildings stand under a light grey sky.

A red banner sits at the top. The word "TEMPO" appears in large red letters above the headline "SATU KOMANDO, SATU PERKAWANAN." Other legible text includes "Modus Kapolres Tersangka Pedofil H.68" and "Ekspansi Agrinas Mengelola Aset Bermasalah H.76." A vertical strip on the left contains a barcode, a QR code, and text including "24-30 MARET 2025" and "RP 60.000." Under the main title, smaller text describes legislative revisions regarding the military.
